Exactly one original mark in each image. High contrast, simple 1–3 broad solid shapes, generous apertures that remain visible small. No fake gradients, shading, glow, texture, shadows or 3D. Quiet, inward, warm, resilient. Fundamentally different structural exploration from other candidates, not merely rotation, stretch or recolor. Crisp vector-like aesthetic. 
SPECIFIC CONSTRUCTION 01: A full near-circular asymmetric SEED kernel with one tiny blunt upper-right shoulder; compact and plump, no leaf tip. One softly undulating horizontal negative-space ribbon held inside.
